d: AISA president and activist Neha Bora addresses a public gathering supporting the impeachment resolution against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Bora accuses the poll body of undermining electoral integrity and bypassing statutory authorities through unauthorised Form 6 modifications. Citing the Election Commission's Supreme Court affidavit, she alleges that millions of vulnerable citizens and youth were disenfranchised via software manipulation. Declaring that the CEC's actions served a partisan political agenda, Bora warns: 'You won't just be impeached, you will be behind bars.'
